editorial.evidence: Compared all 49 captured sections (dumped from source.json HTML with tables) against the rewrite item by item. The four overlapping tracks were folded into one path: the main guide's compact requirement and failure paragraphs were merged with the fuller Full Design tables in steps 3 and 6, the deep-dive incident bullets merged into the complete latency and cost spike dives, and the cheat-sheet kept as Quick review. Expansions are definitions the source assumed (span, trace, correlation ID, tenant, cardinality, exemplar, break-glass, cross-encoder, KV cache, prefill/decode), derived arithmetic that reproduces source figures (110-155 GB storage, 4x/9x queueing, 3.8 days of budget, ~20.2 s stage sum with a percentile caveat), and read-the-table paragraphs for both incident telemetry tables. Two additions are labelled as not from the source: the 0.95^3 sampling illustration and the 100%/90-day changed-constraint question. The Acme German refund trace became the brief's worked example; the external worksheet is disclosed as not imported. All seven figures in both variants are placed beside the text that walks them.
